Subject: Next steps from today's discovery — security/compliance items

Hi Alice + Bob,

Thanks again for taking time today — good conversation and appreciate the clarity on your requirements. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can keep momentum: 

1) SOC 2: You asked about our current SOC 2 status and coverage (Type II, scope). I'll pull the report and confirm whether the current scope covers your data processing needs.

2) Subprocessors: Please send any specific processor questions you have, but we'll share our canonical subprocessor list (cloud providers, telemetry vendors, analytics, monitoring) in a CSV. If you have special restrictions around geographic boundaries or prohibited subprocessors, flag that and we'll surface alternatives.

3) Vendor security questionnaire: Monica from our security org will own initiating the questionnaire and can lead on any follow-ups. Expect a standard vendor questionnaire and a short set of evidence items (network diagrams, encryption at rest keys, SOC 2 report, data retention policy).

4) GDPR / HIPAA applicability: You mentioned potential PHI scope in one route and GDPR residency concerns. Please confirm which product/workloads would be in-scope so we can map controls accordingly.

Proposed timeline: I'll send the subprocessor list by EOD tomorrow (Mon 5/31). Monica will circulate the questionnaire today and we'll target returning answers + artifacts within 7 business days unless you need an accelerated turnaround.

Next steps / owners:
- Marissa (me): share subprocessor list (CSV) — target 2027-05-31 EOD
- Monica (security): send vendor questionnaire and coordinate evidence — today
- Ethan (solutions): will follow up on any deployment/region questions and capture mutual action plan requirements

If that looks right, I'll follow up with the subprocessor CSV.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole

Thanks Marissa — good recap. A couple quick clarifications from our side: 

- SOC 2: we need the latest SOC 2 Type II report and the date range it covers. If there are any carve-outs or in-scope exclusions that would affect processing of customer data, flag those.

- Subprocessors: specifically interested in confirmation of core cloud compute/storage providers (we run some controlled deployments and need explicit answers for AWS/GCP/Azure usage), any third-party analytics/telemetry providers, and whether any subprocessors are located outside the US / EU.

- GDPR / HIPAA: we'll confirm the exact workloads, but please assume there will be a HIPAA question for one of the integrations. If you have a HIPAA/HITECH whitepaper or BAAs template, that would be helpful to see early.

Appreciate the ETA — looking forward to the subprocessor CSV and the questionnaire.

— Bob

Hi Alice + Bob —

As promised, attached is our canonical subprocessor list CSV (redwood_subprocessors_20270530.csv). It includes provider name, role (compute/storage/monitoring), primary region(s), and a brief description of data processed. A few highlights:

- Core cloud compute/storage: AWS (us-west-2 primary), GCP (us-central1 for some workloads), Azure (eu-west for dedicated customer instances)
- Monitoring/telemetry: Datadog (metrics/logs), Sentry (error reporting) — both process aggregated/diagnostic telemetry; we can provide retention and redaction details on request
- Analytics: Snowflake (anonymized usage analytics) — no raw customer PII stored in analytics environment

Attachment: redwood_subprocessors_20270530.csv (stub)
